Why Netball Clubs Order Factory-Direct

Netball is one of the most under-served sports in custom teamwear - Australian clubs routinely pay boutique-reseller prices for dresses that are manufactured offshore anyway. Ordering factory-direct from Sialkot's sportswear cluster removes that markup while keeping the things that matter: proper A-line pattern grading across junior-to-senior sizes, sublimation that survives a season of weekly washes, and stretch fabric that holds its shape.

Runs start at 15–20 dresses - sized for one team including spares - with junior/senior mixed sizing in the same run. Test us first with a trial order, or see the wider sportswear range. DDP delivery to Australia and New Zealand in 3–7 days.

Netball Uniform Questions

What is the minimum order for custom netball dresses?

15-20 dresses per design - one team including spares - with junior and senior sizes mixed freely in the same run. Bib sets start at 10 sets and training wear at 20 pieces.

Can juniors and seniors be sized in the same order?

Yes - our A-line pattern is graded from junior 8 through adult sizes, and one order can mix any size combination at no surcharge. Size sets and a measuring guide are provided before production.

How much does a custom netball dress cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours; comparable sublimated garment baselines on our published pricing page run $11-14 at team MOQs, falling with volume. Bodysuits and bibs are itemized separately.

Do you ship custom netball uniforms to Australia?

Yes - DDP (all duties paid) via DHL/FedEx in 3-7 business days to Australia and New Zealand, which drive most of the world's netball demand. The quote you receive is the landed price.

How long does a netball kit order take?

Free design mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express delivery 3-7 days - inside a typical pre-season window.
